content_sections.heading: IIM Visakhapatnam Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Essential: Minimum one year of experience in applied or quantitative research, analytics, mathematical modelling or software development. Fresh candidates may be considered if they have done good projects during their bachelors.

rows.qualification_required: Essential: BE / B.Tech or M.Sc. in Mathematics or Computer Science, from a recognised university/institution.Desirable: M.Tech / MS / MCA or higher qualification in Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Data Science or a closely related discipline.

content_sections.heading: IIM Visakhapatnam Age Limit
content_sections.text: Not exceeding 30 years as on the last date of application.

rows.relaxation: Relaxation in upper age is applicable as per Government of India rules. The Institute may also consider age relaxation in deserving cases.

faq.question: Q1. What is the IIM Visakhapatnam Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment notification issued by IIM Visakhapatnam to hire 1 Research Associate (Data Science) on a contract basis at the Interdisciplinary Decision Sciences & Analytics Lab (IDeAL).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate (Data Science) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 30th October 2026 by 23:59 Hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE / B.Tech or M.Sc. in Mathematics or Computer Science from a recognised university/institution, with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age of the candidate must not exceed 30 years as on the last date of application, with upper age relaxation applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the IIM Visakhapatnam Research Associate position?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official application form available at www.iimv.ac.in/careers. Physical copies of the application need not be submitted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly pay of ₹ 40,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process may include a written/technical test, personal interview, and/or other assessments in online or physical mode.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a fixed-term contract appointment for one year on monthly consolidated pay, which is extendable based on performance and Institute requirements.
